summary: A worker-job revision is an immutable record under the work item; on workflow.implementation v23 and workflow.break_fix v20 an implementation or design dispatch binds one ready revision through the packet, the dispatch evidence, the report, and the acceptance. A plain accept of a job-bound attempt is local acceptance: it satisfies that revision and holds the step, and whole-work delivery keeps its complete admission. A failed job's correction window closes only on an acceptance that satisfies that job, refining CD-0164 D1-D2 and amending CD-0198 D4 at a job-capable refine step.
title: Worker jobs bind dispatch and separate local acceptance from delivery
